description: Provides access to the user's preferred appearance settings, such as light or dark color schemes, and allows subscribing to changes.

getColorScheme.description: Returns the current user preferred color scheme.
notes: May return null if the user has not specified a preference.
Always returns 'light' when debugging with Chrome.
Value can change later (e.g., system-level theme change, scheduled changes).

setColorScheme.description: Forces the application to adopt a specific color scheme, overriding system preference.
notes: Does not affect system-wide interface style.
Changes apply to the app and all native elements within the app.

addChangeListener.description: Adds an event listener that fires whenever appearance preferences change.
addChangeListener.signature: static addChangeListener(listener: (preferences: { colorScheme: 'light' | 'dark' | null }) => void): NativeEventSubscription

parameters.listener: Function called with updated preferences: { colorScheme }.

addChangeListener.returns: NativeEventSubscription object which can be removed to unsubscribe.
